notes.title: Robot Trivia Funtime v1.1 Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Robot Trivia Funtime[/b] has just received a major update to version 1.1! [/p][p]This update introduces an overhaul of the interface and a brand new menu. You'll notice some awesome additions such as a panel showing popular question packs in the Workshop, and another area displaying the latest news. This is part of a push to make [b]Robot Trivia Funtime[/b] feel and work better with the online Steam features. We've also shifted some of the visuals away from the cotton candy colours and into a more neutral, modern look that better reflects the vibe of the game.[/p][p]In addition, there are also some fixes and patches under the hood to address some issues and improve the quality of how the game runs. There are also some nice additions: a bar now appears at the top of the screen during the game, which shows you which question you're currently on and what category the question is from. There's also a clock and a handy menu button. This version also includes a new bot named Charlie Coffer; he never gets his question wrong but takes a while to read them... how suspicious.[/p][p]This update goes out to both Linux and PC. It's a big change, so let us know how it works for you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Update 1.1[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rebuilt the menu interface[/p][/*][*][p]Added top community question packs to the menu (links to Steam Workshop)[/p][/*][*][p]Added latest news to the menu (links to Steam Community)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new bot 'Charlie Coffer' who never gets a question wrong[/p][/*][*][p]Added UI to the game screen which shows question category and clock[/p][/*][*][p]Changed icon and branding[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes and quality improvements to keep the game working well[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994463/4794b786ecf22134199bab2067b12ce47e9c33ac.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Content Update to Free Demo Version
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994463/4c5fa522d92ccdfc0aa4de6dfecfe94053f03408.png[/img]

[h2]An Update to the Free Demo[/h2]

The free demo of [b]Robot Trivia Funtime[/b] has been updated to reflect the features of the latest full version. This means that all of the recent patches and engine upgrades are now in the demo, as well as the added GUI features and even the cosmetic system. To decorate your robot, simply click on them on the main menu.

As an added bonus, we've doubled the question packs to now include "Film and TV" and "Music". All of the default question packs are bundled in the full version. The full version also features multiplayer mode, configuring question packs, and Workshop features. 

Thanks for trying the demo! That's all for now. See ya!

notes.title: Robot Cosmetic Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994463/285a687f64795143c2713a9c5e9b8125331fa74a.png[/img]
This update introduces cosmetics so you can add a little decoration to your robot! The two main types are hats and chambers, but the groundwork has also been laid for celebration emotes.

To customise your robot, simply click on it on the main menu, and you will be taken to the cosmetic screen.

[h3]Current Cosmetic Items[/h3]
There are 9 [b]hats[/b] to get you started, with more on the way. This includes classics like the tophat and cowboy hat, and some interesting pieces, including the traditional chef toque and the subtle bent antenna. I've been using the hard hat myself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994463/251b3072a965f39fcd63c92bf2d7cbcfb603e37b.png[/img]
The [b]chambers [/b]are a unique cosmetic in Robot Trivia Funtime. These are the big columns behind each robot that flash whenever buttons are pressed and answers are revealed. The default chamber has gone from a solid blue to a pinkish water. There's also two other chambers you can select at the moment: midnight glitter, which is a very moody effect, or peachy robots, featuring tiny robots suspended in water. Don't worry, they can't feel a thing... presumably.

[b]Celebrations[/b] are the next step. This will allow you to pick a custom emote to be played at the end of the game if you win the round. For now, there are no additional celebrations to pick from. 

New cosmetics will be added in subsequent updates. They are ready to use, unlocked and included as part of the game. This update is rolled out in our Windows and Linux versions of Robot Trivia Funtime, but is not currently available in the demo. 

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added avatar customisation UI (click the robot on the main menu!)
[*] Added 9 hats: tophat, paper, mortarboard, antenna, feathered, cowboy, hard hat, crown, chef toque
[*] Added 3 chambers: water, midnight glitter, peachy robots
[*] Adjusted shadow and smoothing on some UI elements
[*] Quiz button glass texture now shows non-selected answers 
[*] Quiz chamber default texture replaced with water chamber
[*] Game view slightly adjusted vertically
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994463/9d37d1db196c536ce72e0f061161a62da855d0ad.png[/img]

Today's [b]Robot Trivia Funtime[/b] patch enables all 12 of the Steam achievements. Each one has a colourful picture... neat!

Apart from the obvious achievements such as winning a game, there's also achievements for flubbing with a score of zero, so you've got no excuse to not start unlocking them.

This patch also slightly adjusts some server code, so you will need to update before joining other games. 

That's all for now! Thank you. ːsteamthumbsupː
